verdict.rationale: Relay supports sending and receiving international wires (docs-9, docs-23) with a clear $10 fee disclosed and waived on Pro plan (relay-comm-5), giving some fee transparency, but there is no evidence of actual local-currency disbursement, FX rate handling, or multi-currency accounts — wires appear to be standard bank wires, not localized payouts. Missing for 10: local currency payment execution, FX rate transparency, multi-currency support evidence, independent confirmation of international payment reliability.
